notes.title: Futa Fix Dick Dine and Dash Godot Version is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[b]New engine, optimized for lightweight systems [/b]

Due to the limitations of our previous engine GameMaker, we have migrated [b]Futa Fix Dick Dine and Dash[/b] to Godot vastly improving the game's performance and removing critical bugs.

The previous version under GameMaker2 hosted over 30+ bugs, which have now been fixed. The newest iteration running in Godot has been put through extensive testing over the last 8 months.

Anyone who has previously encountered problems with running the game or experienced game-breaking bugs is encouraged to reinstall the game.

Previous saves will not work with this new version of the game due to the engine migration.

[b]Upcoming patches and updates[/b]
----------------

Quality of Life Updates:
- Navigation improvements and optimization for SteamDeck
- New animated scenes, upgraded from existing still art, and quality improvements of existing art

Coming in 2024:
- Brand new route with never-before-seen art and animations featuring a new female character  

Thank you for your patience and supporting the development of Futa Fix Dick Dine and Dash.

notes.title: Futa Fix Bugfix Update: 12282020
notes.notes:
Greetings, futa fans!

We have updated the game with a new bug-fixing build.

Due to the major nature of the bug fixes we recommend all players to reinstall their game.

[b]Changelog:[/b]

- Fixed a bug that made Linda's last sex scene inaccessible, which in turn rendered the "Sweet Release" achievement inaccessible.
- Fixed a bug that turned off all voice acting in Kate's route.
- Fixed a bug where the New game Warning prompt would show even if the player did not have a savefile.
- Resolved miscellaneous music issues.
- Fixed miscellaneous graphical issues: Lilly's face shadow, Clover's face misalignment, etc.
- Implemented miscellaneous script fixes.

[b]Additional updates:[/b]

- Expanded the Gallery to include more CGs.

We are still working to identify the cause of some major bugs in the game causing some players to be unable to see CGs and animations as well as other issues.

notes.title: Regarding Bugs, Future Updates, and Fixes
notes.notes:
Greetings, futa fans!

Many of you have been addressing several game-breaking and crashing bugs to us over the last two days ever since the game released.

We have already deployed two updates to address some of the issues affecting the game, however, our fixes have not worked for everyone.

We will continue to investigate and address severe issues present for some users and continue to release updates in order to stabilize the gameplay experience for everyone.

Thank you for supporting the game thus far and for your continued patience with us.

notes.title: Futa Fix Bugfix Update: 12232020
notes.notes:
Greetings, futa fans! 

We have updated the game with a new bug-fixing build.

Due to the major nature of the bug fixes we recommend all players to reinstall their game.

[b]Changelog:
[/b]
- The new update will delete all preexisting save files to prevent save corruption and crashes due to mismatched game versions.
- Fixed a problem with voiced lines getting interrupted by the auto-read function.
- Fixed a pathing problem causing players to get stuck on "Neutral Endings" for select routes even when meeting requirements for "Good Endings"
- Fixed miscellaneous spelling, grammar, and stylistic errors.
- Fixed some of the control options not working properly in the Gallery.
- Fixed crashing on save loading in the Simplified Chinese-language version of the game.

[b]Additional updates:[/b]

- DirectX 11 will now be bundled with the new updated versions of the game to fix animation playback problems and black screen problems where CGs would normally appear.
- The game's window can now be resized by clicking and dragging its borders.
- Updated the CG content of the Gallery.
- Added a warning prompt for the New Game option on the Title Screen.

notes.title: Futa Fix Hotfix: 12222020
notes.notes:
Hey, guys. I hope a lot of you enjoying [b]Futa Fix Dick Dine and Dash[/b] despite the reported problems.

We're currently working diligently on implementing fixes and solutions to the bugs, glitches, and inconsistencies present in the release.

Here are the problems we managed to address in the current fix for the game:

- Crashing at game startup has been fixed.
- A logic error connected to game pathing that was not working as intended has been addressed.
- Addressed missing character portrait assets.
- Missing effects were implemented correctly.
- An issue that was causing video crashes at the start of the game has been addressed with a redistributable that can be downloaded and installed when the game first installs to the Steam Library.

We recommend users to remove their save data by going into AppData\Local\FutaFix and deleting the files there, after downloading a new version of the game.

Trying to load saves from a previous version may cause unwanted crashes.

More fixes and updates will be coming soon and we will be addressing them prioritizing the most severe problems.
